messages:
oliver: Quick recap from today's design crit about the API key flows. Main themes: 'suspend' vs 'permanent delete' language, undo duration, bulk-suspend affordances, and the create/rotate disclosure. Trying to capture decisions.
maddie: Thanks. First thing: we used the word 'revoke' everywhere which is ambiguous. Proposal: use 'Suspend' for the temporary removal (recoverable within the retention window) and reserve 'Permanently delete' for after the retention period. 'Suspend' reads less alarming.
kevin: Backend note: retention window is currently 30 days by default but can be configured per-org. Should we surface the window dynamically, e.g., 'Suspended — expires in 45 days' if org overrides? Frontend should read retention_days from the project metadata.
yasmin: Copy suggestion for single-key modal: Header: 'Suspend key'. Body: 'This will suspend the key from active use. Suspended keys can be restored for the next 30 days (org-specific). After that they will be permanently deleted.' Primary: 'Suspend key' (destructive), Secondary: 'Cancel'.
oliver: Undo timing: product asked about longer undo to reduce help tickets. Research team suggested 12s for batch actions. Consensus: make the toast duration 12s, show an explicit 'Undo' button, and only render 'Undo' when the user has restore permissions. For users who can't restore, toast should read: 'Key suspended' with a link 'Request restore' that opens a support flow.
maddie: Accessibility: toast must use role='status' and aria-live='polite'. The Undo should be keyboard-focusable. When toast appears, do not move focus to it automatically; instead surface a screen-reader-only announcement that says 'X key(s) suspended. Press Alt+U to undo' (we'll add a documented keyboard shortcut).
kevin: Bulk suspend behavior: API returns per-key status. Do not block the entire operation if some keys are org-managed or protected. Gray out non-actionable keys in the bulk selection UI with inline reason text: 'Org managed  contact admin'. After the operation show a summary panel: '7 suspended, 2 skipped (org policy)'. The panel should be a side-sheet that traps focus and lists per-key outcomes.
yasmin: Visual tone: use an amber/warm-warning for suspend modals and badges. Reserve red/danger only for the permanent delete flow or when retention_days == 0. Run contrast checks to make sure badge text passes AA.
oliver: Rotate UX: keep rotate as a separate flow. Do not bundle rotate into the suspend modal. But offer a small inline link: 'Want to rotate instead?' that opens the rotate dialog. Also, in rotate modal, explicitly call out whether rotate keeps the key id or creates a new key. Two radio options: 'Rotate secret (keep key id)' and 'Create replacement key (new id)'. Provide bullets for tradeoffs.
maddie: Secret visibility after rotate/create: show the secret in a success drawer, but do not auto-download. Provide two explicit actions: 'Copy secret' and 'Download secret'. Copy must announce success via aria-live and fallback gracefully if clipboard is blocked. Show a masked preview with 'Show' toggle; when revealed announce 'Secret revealed. It will not be shown again.'
kevin: I18n: don't concat strings for expiry. Use ICU or localized templates for 'Expires in 1 day' vs 'Expires in 2 days'. Also provide an exact ISO timestamp in a tooltip for auditing.
yasmin: Keyboard & focus rules: modals must trap focus; after confirming suspend the focus should remain on the modal until user dismisses the summary, to avoid focus jumps. For bulk summary side-sheet, Escape closes and returns focus to the original bulk action checkbox.
oliver: Empty state ideas for keys list: current empty state is bland. New suggestion: header 'No API keys yet' plus two CTAs: primary 'Create a key' and secondary 'Request an org key'. Add a short checklist: '1) Create key 2) Store secret 3) Rotate regularly'. Also include a small link to 'Key lifecycles & best practices'. This should cut down on support tickets.
maddie: Error states: if suspend fails due to policy, show inline per-key error next to the row with a small tooltip 'Org-managed keys cannot be suspended by members' and an action 'Request admin action'. For network errors, show a retry affordance in the summary panel.
kevin: Telemetry: emit events for suspend_attempt, suspend_result (per id), undo_clicked, rotate_attempt. Include actor, scope, and retention_days so analytics can measure how often users rely on undo.
yasmin: A11y tests: add screen reader scenario that verifies: 1) toast uses polite live region with counts; 2) side-sheet is announced and focus is trapped; 3) secret copy announces success; 4) expiry text uses localized pluralization.
oliver: (typo) Action items: 1) Update copy to 'Suspend' language and add retention_days token; 2) Set toast undo duration to 12s and gate Undo by restore perms; 3) Change visual token to amber for suspend flows and run contrast checks; 4) Implement partial success handling + side-sheet with per-key statuses; 5) Keep rotate separate but add inline link to open rotate modal; 6) Update empty state copy and CTAs; 7) Add telemetry events and a11y tests. I'll file a tiny spec and tag eng/analytics/a11y. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
